name: web-planner-codex
description: Automatically coordinate read-only ChatGPT planning with local Codex execution.

interface.shortDescription: ChatGPT plans from read-only context; Codex executes locally.
interface.longDescription: Routes repository tasks, exchanges structured plans with an existing ChatGPT conversation, and keeps all file changes and command execution inside Codex.
defaultPrompt: Decide whether this task needs ChatGPT planning, then complete it safely.
Use ChatGPT to plan this multi-stage repository change, then execute it locally.
